notes.title: Deadswitch Combat
notes.content:
[b]Deadswitch Combat[/b], the successor to Deadswitch 3, is back under development!

[h1]What to Expect[/h1]
[list]
[*] New game engine, built from the ground up for best performance
[*] Enhanced soldier customization, including weapon attachments, skins, and more
[*] Full in-game editor to create custom maps and missions
[*] Workshop and mod support
[*] Beta playtest sessions before public release
[/list]

If you're interested in participating in beta playtests or learning more, join the dedicated Discord here:
[url=https://discord.gg/B9vKMRz4ut]https://discord.gg/B9vKMRz4ut[/url]

[i]Deadswitch 3 will still receive updates and new content, but the focus is Deadswitch Combat for the future.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.6.9
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.6.9[/b] introduces the Operation Editor, an in-game tool that lets you create your own missions!

[h1]Operation Editor[/h1]
Create your own missions with the new Operation Editor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40197790/670a2f2b259a461bbe87bfa75eae33a8666f0b18.png[/img] 

The editor is integrated with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1131080/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url], allowing you to share your own missions or browse community missions.

Check out the guide here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3214649587

[h1]Other Notes[/h1]
- [b]Motion Sensors[/b] and [b]Jammers[/b] can now be thrown
- Added [b]Napalm[/b] attachment for Shotguns
- Added new hero: [b]Agent 1237[/b]
- New character animations for NPCs
- UI and music updates
- Performance optimizations

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Remember to [url=https://discord.com/invite/9Ghmd2bb]join the official Discord server[/url], now with a dedicated Operation Editor channel!

notes.title: Deadswitch 3 on Steam
notes.content:
Welcome to Deadswitch 3! 

For previous players, you can continue to use your Deadswitch 3 account in the Steam version and continue from where you left off. Steam players have access to Steam Cloud, friends integration, achievements, stats, and more!

For new players, welcome! Deadswitch 3 is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer shooter with hundreds of weapons, multiple maps and game modes, and limitless customization. The Deadswitch series started as a simple browser Flash game and has since moved onto a complete 2D multiplayer experience.

There is only 1 developer behind the Deadswitch series! The game is built around the community, so don't be shy to request new features.

[h1]Overview[/h1]

Deadswitch 3 is split into 3 primary game types: Ranked, Operations, and Survival.

[h2]Ranked[/h2]

Ranked games make up the core of Deadswitch 3, allowing players to earn XP and progress through the ranks to unlock new weapons, equipment, killstreaks, perks, and more.

Such game modes include Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and others. Ranked games can support up to 10 players in a single match. If you're looking for intense team-based gameplay, Ranked should be your choice.

You have access to Classes, which allow you to customize your primary weapon, secondary weapon, perks, and killstreaks.

[h2]Operations[/h2]

Operations are a Ranked game variation where the player can play an objective-based mission, set the desired difficulty, and earn rewards. The harder the difficulty, the better the rewards!

You still earn XP towards your Ranked profile in Operations. You can play Operations solo or with another teammate online. For more difficult missions, having a teammate is highly recommended.

[h2]Survival[/h2]

Survival games have one goal: to survive as long as possible.

There are multiple Survival game modes, such as Undead Survival, Chaos Survival, or Stakeout Survival. Kill endless waves of enemies, earn money, and submit your score in the worldwide leaderboards.

Survival games still earn a small of XP towards your Ranked profile. Survival games consist of 4-6 players per match.

[h1]Deadswitch 3 Account[/h1]

A Deadswitch 3 account is recommended to play, but not required. It allows you to save your profile data and access it on any device (even outside of Steam Cloud)! This is particular useful for players who switch between the web version and PC version.

While optional, logging into a Deadswitch 3 account does have benefits. It allows you create/join clans, to be shown in the multiplayer and Survival leaderboards, and access your profile on different platforms.

[h1]Shards[/h1]

Shards are the in-game currency of Deadswitch 3. They are used to unlock weapons, attachments, perks, killstreaks, character items, and more.

[img]https://xwilkinx.com/content/images/shard_icon.png[/img] [i]Shard Icon[/i]

[h2]How to Get Shards[/h2]

There are multiple ways to get Shards in Deadswitch 3:

[list]
[*]Level up in Ranked
[*]Loot Shards from Battlezone games
[*]Complete multiplayer challenges
[*]Complete clan challenges
[*]Receive 1 Shard for every 10 Operation Stars you earn
[*]Complete Veteran Operations
[/list]

You can also purchase Shards directly from the [b]Get Shards[/b] menu.

[h1]More Info[/h1]

Check out these useful Deadswitch 3 links!

[list]
